## Usage notes

- **Amazon Web Services, AWS, the Powered by AWS logo, and the AWS "smile" logo** are trademarks
  of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. Use per the
  [AWS Trademark Guidelines](https://aws.amazon.com/trademark-guidelines/) and the
  [Powered by AWS Logo Program](https://aws.amazon.com/co-marketing/).
- **Kiro** and the Kiro logo are trademarks of their owner; the logo is used per Kiro brand usage.
- Do not stretch, recolor, or alter the marks. Preserve clear space and use the reverse (white)
  variant on dark backgrounds.
- These assets are referenced for identification in official AWS + Kiro training and do not
  imply any additional endorsement beyond that program.
